Mill Street bakery wins regional prize

2 April 2026

A family bakery on Mill Street has taken the top prize at this year's Western Grain Awards, beating forty-one entries from across the region.

Judges praised the rye loaf for its open crumb and "a sourness that arrives late and leaves politely". The bakery bakes six hundred loaves a day, all from a single oven built in 1962.

Share on X Share by mail

Owner Priya Venkataraman said she would put the prize money into a second oven so the shop can stop turning away wholesale customers.
